notes:
ペット is a loanword from English "pet," referring to animals kept for companionship.

- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧: dog

- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧: fish
- ハムスター: hamster

Japan has a large pet industry. Many apartments are ペット⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧, so pet-friendly housing (ペット{可|か}⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧) is sought after.
